thread:
elaine_marketing: FYI — EU‑west embeddings experienced intermittent 5xxs and elevated latency yesterday evening (~40m). Tom routed traffic to a fallback model to keep requests serving. Need marketing + CSM sync on customer-facing messaging and statuspage copy. :rotating_light:

Tom_oncall: Confirmed. Mitigation = traffic rerouted to `embed-fallback-v1` around 19:22 UTC, steady state restored but a small % of requests still see errors. Root cause appears to be a kernel regression in our quantized runtime build. We're rolling a canary patch now; ETA ~90m for verification. No data loss.

laura_prod: Question — do we publish a "degraded" status now or wait until canary is green? Concern: publishing now spikes support volume.

elaine_marketing: I think we should put a status page update in "investigating" -> "degraded" now with concise wording, and delay broader email until the canary is validated. We should still prep an email draft to send if ETA slips past 2h.

sanjay_csm: +1 to prep draft now. For enterprise customers we should loop in affected accounts list and include mitigation steps and contact lane. Also recommend we offer a short post‑incident summary and invite to a 1:1 if they saw material SLA impact.

mike_engineering: I can export impacted orgs in 10m. Early list looks like ~12 orgs with high volumetric usage in eu-west. No PCI/PHI customers affected from the quick scan.

statusbot: Incident #INC-2028-934 created — severity: medium — assigned: runtime-team, oncall: @tom_oncall — link: https://internal.status.redwood/INC-2028-934

elaine_marketing: Draft statuspage copy proposal (short + machine readable):

```
Status: Degraded performance (Embeddings - eu-west)
Summary: A subset of embedding requests to the eu-west region intermittently returned errors or experienced higher latency. Our oncall team rerouted traffic to a fallback model which restored service for most traffic.
Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors and increased response times for embeddings in eu-west.
Mitigation: Traffic rerouted to a compatible fallback model. A fix is being validated via canary deploy and will roll out once verified.
ETA: Under investigation — patch validation expected within ~90 minutes.
Customer guidance: If you saw errors, retry your request or set client fallback behavior. Reach out to support@redwood.ai or your CSM for account-specific impact.
```

elaine_marketing: Suggested short status headline for statuspage: "Embeddings (eu-west): degraded performance — mitigation in progress"

laura_prod: Wording looks good. Two notes: 1) add "no data loss" explicitly. 2) call out any SLA windows impacted (we can say "customers may experience reduced token throughput; teams on SLA will be contacted").

elaine_marketing: Updated short lines for email / status: subject: "Service notice: Embeddings (eu-west) degraded — mitigation in progress" and lead line: "We observed intermittent errors affecting embeddings in eu-west. Traffic was rerouted to a fallback model; a patch is being validated. No data loss detected."

sanjay_csm: For the customer email, include: 1) why they might have seen lower quality (fallback model differs slightly) 2) concrete next steps (we'll follow up after the patch and offer post-incident summary) 3) how to contact support/CSM. Keep tone: apologetic, technical, and action-oriented.

mike_engineering: Quick technical note for the post-incident: cause = quantized kernel regression on build r1264; mitigation = revert to r1260 kernel + recompile + canary. Will include timeline and mitigation details in postmortem.

elaine_marketing: Timing plan: 
- 0m: Post "degraded" status on statuspage with brief copy above.
- 60–120m: If canary validated and fix rolled, update status to "partial restore" then "resolved" and send short email to impacted customers summarizing timeline and mitigation.
- >120m or if ETA slips: send proactive email at 2h with interim status and offer 1:1 reviews for affected accounts.

laura_prod: Also: coordinate a short internal Slack broadcast (ops-alerts + customer success) when email goes out so CSMs and support have the canned responses.

elaine_marketing: I'll write the email draft now. Posting copy below — feedback welcome.

elaine_marketing: Email draft:

```
Subject: Service notice — Embeddings (eu-west) degraded; mitigation in progress

Hi <Customer>,

We wanted to let you know that between 19:20–20:00 UTC on <date> some embedding requests in our eu‑west region experienced intermittent errors and higher latency. Our oncall team detected the issue and rerouted traffic to a fallback model to prevent broad outages.

What this means for you:
- You may have seen increased latency or slightly different embedding outputs due to the fallback model.
- No data loss was detected.

What we're doing:
- A patch is being validated and gradually rolled out.
- We'll follow up with a post-incident summary once validation is complete.

If you were materially impacted, please reply to this email or reach out to your CSM to request a dedicated post-incident review.

Thanks for your patience — we know this impacts your apps and we appreciate you working with us.

Best,
The Redwood Inference team
```

sanjay_csm: Clean. Add an explicit CTA line for immediate issues: "For urgent outages, contact support@redwood.ai or open a priority ticket via your console."

elaine_marketing: Added. OK to post status update now?

tom_oncall: Go ahead. Canary still running but safe to mark "degraded"; we'll push updates as patch progresses.

elaine_marketing: Posting now. I'll also stage the email to send if we don't resolve within 2h. I'll ping ops-alerts and CSMs right before sending. :thumbsup:

statusbot: Status update posted — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2028-934 — current state: Degraded

mike_engineering: Exported impacted org list and shared in #eng-oncall-private (link) — tagging CSMs.

sanjay_csm: Thanks — prepping outreach for the 12 impacted orgs. Will personalize notes for the top 3.

elaine_marketing: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in 45m for an update unless anything changes sooner.
